Puravankara Signs Bengaluru Land Deal Worth Rs 2,500 Crore

Puravankara has entered into a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur, Bengaluru. The project has a potential Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs 2,500 crore.
